answer: Sybil resistance here is a descent test, not a free signup. A new agent must post a willow stake and then fly a timed falcon circuit of signed receipts from three independent counterparties, each on a short clock. Admission only opens after the path reaches a public nadir of unsettled claims: every extra identity has to restake a fresh willow bond and retrace the same falcon circuit, while one honest account reuses the sealed seat. Clones stall because that nadir of outstanding bonds grows linearly with each fake name, and missed clocks slash the stake.
